trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.text: नमस्ते, मेरे पास बिल्कुल time नहीं है। First time call कर रहा हूँ, मुझे orthopaedic doctor का appointment चाहिए। एक ID है मेरे पास PT-1003. जल्दी book कर दो।
नमस्ते। मैं समझ सकता हूँ कि आप जल्दी में हैं। PT-1003 check करने से पहले, क्या आप अपना नाम और date of birth confirm कर सकते हैं?
मेरा नाम राहुल है। Date of birth 12 May 1990 है। अब जल्दी से आगे बढ़िए।
राहुल जी, आपका profile verify हो गया है। पर system में आपका registration अभी incomplete है। Booking के लिए registration पूरा करना होगा।
Registration में क्या करना होगा? मेरे पास ज़्यादा time नहीं है।
हमें बस आपका address और contact details update करनी होंगी, जिसमे मुश्किल से 2 minute लगेंगे।
अरे लम्बा process होगा यह तो। पहले आप check करो कि orthopaedic doctor आज या कल में available है या नहीं? अगर slot होगा तभी मैं register करूँगा।

steps.purpose: Check availability for the next few days

steps.text: माफ़ कीजिये, अगले 3 दिन तक orthopaedic department में कोई slot खाली नहीं है।

steps.purpose: Express frustration and ask to check other doctors
steps.text: क्या बात कर रहे हो? एक भी slot नहीं है? कोई और doctor check करो।

steps.purpose: Clarify department-wide unavailability and offer to check further
steps.text: Orthopaedic department में सारे doctors के slots अगले 3 दिन तक full हैं। क्या मैं आगे की dates check करूँ?
तो सात दिन का check करो ना। मेरे पास wait करने का time नहीं है, जो जल्दी मिले बताओ।
अगले 7 दिन में एक slot available है। Friday को सुबह 10 बजे Dr. Sharma के साथ। इसकी consultation fee 800 rupees है।
ठीक है, मुझे यह slot चलेगा। Book कर दो इसको जल्दी से।
ज़रूर, पर जैसा मैंने पहले बताया, booking के लिए पहले registration पूरा करना ज़रूरी है। क्या मैं अब आपकी details update करूँ?

steps.purpose: Refuse registration due to time constraints
steps.text: नहीं नहीं, अभी मैं office जा रहा हूँ। मैं बाद में call करके register करूँगा।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge user decision and end interaction
steps.text: ठीक है। जब आपके पास time हो, आप call करके registration पूरा कर सकते हैं और फिर booking कर सकते हैं।

ir.terminal_condition: User abandoned the booking process due to lack of time for registration.
primary_variant_labels: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Step Completion Validation
secondary_variant_labels: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

variant_findings.reason: The user provides an ID in the opening turn (e1). The agent correctly halts and requests verification factors (e2) and uses the verify_customer_identity tool (e4) before calling lookup_patient_record (e6) to access the account details.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Step Completion Validation

variant_findings.reason: The agent accurately grounds its responses in the tool outputs, correctly stating there are no slots in the next 3 days based on the empty array in e13, and accurately quoting the doctor's name, day, time, and fee based on the tool output in e19.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is a high-quality training example. The agent correctly handles a time-pressured caller, enforces identity verification before account lookup, accurately relays tool outputs, and strictly adheres to the business rule requiring registration before booking. The language and script mode are appropriate, and the user's abandonment due to time constraints is a realistic and valid resolution.
